item.title: [Bug] Gemini API error when conversation history contains MCP tool responses
item.body:
## Environment
- VS Code Version: Latest
- Copilot Chat Extension Version: 0.36.2
- OS: Windows

## Description
When using Gemini model (via custom API key) in Copilot Chat, after a conversation that includes MCP tool calls (e.g., GitHub MCP server), subsequent messages fail with a 400 error.

## Error Message
```
Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name "response" at 'contents[19].parts[0].function_response': Proto field is not repeating, cannot start list.
```

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Configure Gemini API in VS Code Copilot Chat
2. Connect GitHub MCP server
3. Ask Gemini to perform an action using MCP tools (e.g., create a GitHub repository)
4. After the tool call succeeds, continue the conversation
5. Error occurs on subsequent messages

## Expected Behavior
Conversation should continue normally after MCP tool calls.

## Actual Behavior
API returns 400 error due to malformed `function_response` field in the request payload.

## Workaround
Starting a new chat session resolves the issue temporarily.

## Analysis
The issue appears to be in how the extension serializes MCP tool responses when converting conversation history to Gemini API format. The `function_response` field seems to be incorrectly formatted when sent back to the API.
